mapper.select: SELECT id FROM sys_permission WHERE code = 'cms:role:assign' FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, status FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, status FROM sys_role WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT id FROM sys_role WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'ENABLED'
AND id IN #{id}
AND 1 = 0
ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE

SELECT id FROM sys_permission WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'ENABLED'
AND id IN #{id}
AND 1 = 0
ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user_role(user_id, role_id, created_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{roleId}, #{actorId})
INSERT INTO sys_role_permission(role_id, permission_id, created_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{permissionId}, #{actorId})
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT u.id FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.id JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE u.deleted = 0 AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 'ENABLED' AND p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 'ENABLED' AND p.code IN ('cms:role:assign', 'cms:permission:manage') GROUP BY u.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.code) = 2 )
